about.bio:
Robert Baskin is a writer and Ph.D. candidate in the English department at Boston College, where he studies Weird fiction, modernism, and philosophical aesthetics. His dissertation compares modernism and weird fiction's responses to various crises in the late 19th and early 20th century.

Before graduate school he worked as an elementary school teacher. His writing has appeared in academic journals and magazines. He is always happy to talk with students, journalists, critics, and fellow researchers.
